core_claim: Locate pedestrian degradation across fixed GT motion bins and test whether same-batch class-gradient conflict and frequency-weighted pressure increase after Stage4A.

evidence_chain.stage4ae_pedestrian_motion_bin_fde: Paired frozen Stage3B/Stage4A population means in the five fixed bins, with bar labels.
evidence_chain.stage4ae_pedestrian_motion_delta: Delta minFDE with paired official VAL scene-cluster 95% bootstrap intervals and a zero line.
evidence_chain.stage4ae_gradient_cosine_comparison: Compare the same five shared groups across two checkpoints, with paired batch-resampling model-mean intervals.
evidence_chain.stage4ae_global_gradient_conflict_distri: Show the 100 ALL SHARED cosine observations per model and x=0 conflict boundary.
evidence_chain.stage4ae_class_gradient_norm: Stage4A ALL SHARED class-mean gradient norms before frequency weighting.
evidence_chain.stage4ae_gradient_pressure: Stage4A ALL SHARED mean coordinate-share-weighted gradient norm proxy, on a separate axis/figure.

statistics.motion: 54990 frozen full-horizon VAL actors; 12002 pedestrian actor-windows; paired scene bootstrap 1000 replicates seed2022; no multiple-comparison correction.
statistics.gradient: 100 identical qualifying TRAIN batches from deterministic index order, one frozen checkpoint per model; batch bootstrap 1000 replicates seed2022 is an optimization diagnostic, not scene-cluster model significance.
statistics.pressure: Means over the same 100 batches; proxy is not the exact algebraic decomposition of original mixed-loss gradients.

review_risks: Motion bins use future GT displacement for offline diagnosis and cannot be supplied directly at inference.
Low-count bins/cells require their unique scene counts; contextual comparisons remain descriptive.
Sequential batches and overlapping windows are dependent and not representative of all TRAIN700.
Model-mean error bars do not replace paired DeltaCos intervals.
Gradient conflict does not establish causation of pedestrian degradation.
Class gradient losses have their own mean reductions; actor frequency and coordinate frequency are reported separately.
Mean per-batch pressure ratios differ from the ratio of mean pressures.
